sonnet.problem: The right answer "Both are preserved" stands out. It is the shortest option, it copies the BSB's own wording ("preserved"), and "Both" has no antecedent in the answer. The wrong answers ("The wine turns sweet", "The skins stretch out") are plain and casual, so the right one sounds more like the Bible than the rest.
sonnet.rule: Don't let the right answer stand out. All the answers should sound alike. None should sound more like the Bible, or more modern, than the others.
